translations.web: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.
translations.bsb: where for forty days He was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and when they had ended, He was hungry.
translations.kjv: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
